source.title: Banbridge Chronicle, 12 October 1946, p. 2 ("Rural District of Banbridge: Notice of Result of Elections (Returning Officer, dated 5 October 1946)"); Belfast News-Letter, 5 October 1946, p. 3 ("County and rural council elections: Ulster election results")
source.publisher: Banbridge Chronicle (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: votes from column 5 of the Returning Officer's notice (227 and 63), read on the BNA page image; the notice sets both names in column 6 against their rows, but only one seat was filled and the News-Letter (5 Oct 1946 p. 3) reports Chambers elected (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026).

note: Triennial election of Banbridge Rural District Council, polled Thursday 3 October 1946. Scarva was the only contested division. The Returning Officer's notice of result (Banbridge Chronicle, 12 October 1946, p. 2) names the member elected or deemed re-elected for all twenty divisions: twelve unopposed nominations, Scarva polled, seven divisions with no nomination and Tullylish (nomination invalid), whose sitting members were deemed re-elected. The 'U.' labels are from the News-Letter result; the notice prints none.
